title: Forsak3n ( OP script free gui MoonHub )
features:
[Info]
[+] Killer Info auto-refresh panel (name, username, abilities used)

[Discord]
[+] Join our Discord server section (auto-fetch name/description/icon)
[+] Copy invite link button

[Generator]
[+] Auto Generator (auto complete when within range)
[+] Auto Enter Generator (invokes “enter” when close)

[Items]
[+] Select Items To Pick Up (multi-select)
[+] Auto Pick Up Selected Items (uses proximity prompts)

[Sprint]
[+] No Stamina Loss (survivor only)
[+] Always Sprint (survivor only)

[Generator Visual]
[+] Esp Generator (highlights all generators)
[+] Esp Finished Generator (toggle)
[+] Esp UnFinished Generator (toggle)
[+] Finished Generator Esp Color FillColor
[+] Finished Generator Esp Color OutlineColor
[+] UnFinished Generator Esp Color FillColor
[+] UnFinished Generator Esp Color OutlineColor

[Item Visual]
[+] Select Items To Esp (multi-select)
[+] Esp Selected Items
[+] Item Esp Color FillColor
[+] Item Esp Color OutlineColor

[Killer Visual]
[+] Esp Killer
[+] Killer Esp Color FillColor
[+] Killer Esp Color OutlineColor

[Survivor Visual]
[+] Esp Survivor
[+] Survivor Esp Color FillColor
[+] Survivor Esp Color OutlineColor

[Player]
[+] Fly
[+] Fly Speed Amount (scroll-wheel adjustable & slider)
[+] No Clip
[+] Walk Speed (BodyVelocity based)
[+] Walk Speed Amount
[+] Jump Power
[+] Jump Power Amount
[+] Max Camera Zoom (input + slider)

[Optimization]
[+] Remove Shadow (disables GlobalShadows & CastShadow)
[+] Remove Effect (destroys all Effect instances)
[+] Remove Particle Emitter
[+] Remove Animation (destroys AnimationController)

[Config]
[+] Config Name input
[+] List existing configs (dropdown)
[+] Refresh Dropdown
[+] Save Config
[+] Load Config

[Settings]
[+] FPS Cap (slider)
[+] Join Private Server (Free)
[+] Server Hop
[+] Server Hop (Lowest Server)

[Theme & UI]
[+] Select Theme (Dark, Light, Rose, Plant, Red, Indigo, Sky, Violet, Amber, Emerald, Midnight, Crimson, Monokai Pro, Cotton Candy, Rainbow)
[+] Set Theme
[+] UI Transparency toggle
[+] Custom Open Button (gradient, draggable, mobile option)
